guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build fails at step 6 due to this error: "update-alternatives: <link> and <path> can't be the same" while running the command `update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/python3 python3 /usr/bin/python3.11 1 && update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/pip3 pip3 /usr/bin/pip3 1`. To fix this, revise the second update-alternatives command for pip3 to point to the correct pip3 binary path (likely /usr/bin/pip3.11 or another specific pip binary installed by the python3.11 installation), not /usr/bin/pip3 itself. Verify the correct path of pip3.11 by inspecting the image or installing python3-pip properly. Also, check for unnecessary redundant update-alternatives commands that could cause conflict.
